summary: Iteration 36: Comprehensive testing of NexusOps Inventory & Procurement features. Backend APIs 27/27 passing (100%). Frontend UI tests 24/25 passing (96%). All new features functional: Purchase Orders with stats, CRUD, audit trail, ping/escalation; Stocktake with sessions, counting, variance tracking, finalization, reports; Product Bundling; Ticket Itemization with push to invoice; On-order indicators; Vendor Create PO button.
seed_data_creation: Test POs and stocktake sessions created during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 tested all new inventory/procurement features. Backend APIs all working. Purchase Orders page shows list with stats, Create/Edit/Delete/Submit functionality, Receive Stock dialog, Escalations check, Audit Trail tab. Stocktake page has Sessions/Reports tabs, session detail shows item counting, variance tracking, finalize button (for in_progress sessions). Products page has Bundle tab to link products. Tickets page has Items tab for adding billable products with push to invoice. Vendors page shows PO quick-action button on each vendor row.

purchase_orders.details: PO page with stats (Total, Draft, Ordered, Partial, Total Value), list with search/filter, Create PO dialog with vendor/items/tech assignment, PO detail with Items/Audit tabs, Submit to Vendor, Receive Stock dialog with barcode scanner, Check Escalations button

stock_receiving.details: Receive stock endpoint updates line items received_qty, changes PO status to partial/received, creates stock movement records, increases product quantity_in_stock

po_audit_trail.details: Audit log records all PO actions (created, status_changed, stock_received, escalated), visible in Audit Trail tab

po_ping_escalation.details: Check Escalations button triggers ping/escalation check, settings endpoint for tech_ping_hours and escalation_hours

stocktake_sessions.details: Sessions list with stats cards, create new session captures all products, session detail shows items with Expected/Counted/Variance/Status

stocktake_counting.details: Count items individually or batch, barcode scanner input for quick counting, variance calculated automatically

stocktake_finalize.details: Finalize session applies stock adjustments, creates stock movement records, marks session completed

stocktake_reports.details: Reports tab shows Stock Value Summary (Cost/Retail), Net Variance, Low Stock Products list, On Order Value

stocktake_audit.details: Audit trail records session_created, item_counted, session_finalized events

product_bundling.details: Bundle tab in product detail, add/remove products to bundle, bundle cost/retail totals displayed

on_order_indicator.details: Products with items on open POs show cyan truck icon with quantity ordered, on-order-summary endpoint returns all products on order

ticket_itemization.details: Items tab on tickets, Add Item button to add billable products, Push to Invoice button creates new invoice or adds to existing

vendor_create_po.details: Vendors page shows PO quick-action button on each row, vendor detail has Create PO button that links to PO creation
